sources.snippet: One 128 GB box. Three files. A model whose official checkpoint is 510 GB. ① a 113.6 GB general base → ② a ~40 MB domain sidecar → ③ a post-training file re-solved every night. ds4 is a native C/CUDA inference engine plus an offline toolchain that runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB unified memory).
